verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5090 is a graphics card. Versioning, reviewing and rolling back user automations is a workflow-platform capability, not a fair question for GPU hardware, so this is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships any automation-management feature; the NVIDIA app updating DLSS models is unrelated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
